resources.string: Allow notifications, then restart the search for sound and vibration alerts.
Network settings are unavailable on this phone.

Prepare
Connect the VPN. Put the PC on the same Wi-Fi network or phone Wi-Fi/USB tethering. Open Settings → Share VPN with a computer.

Configure
Select the local address and start. Set the PC HTTP and HTTPS proxy to the displayed address and port, and enter the credentials. Use a trusted LAN.

Scope
Only proxy-aware applications use the VPN. TCP is supported, UDP is not. This does not automatically route all hotspot traffic through the VPN.

Stop
Keep this screen open. STOP, closing this screen or a changed/disconnected VPN session ends sharing. Remove the PC proxy afterwards if necessary.

Start
Connect the VPN, open Settings → Test VPN speed and tap START. Watch the animated phases.

Results
HTTPS latency is in milliseconds; download and upload are in Mbps. About 10 MB passes through the VPN. Results depend on signal, servers and other traffic.

Save data
Avoid unnecessary repeat tests. STOP cancels the measurement. A VPN disconnect stops the test without switching to direct Internet.

Purchase or renew
Open BECOME A RESELLER, choose a duration and check the price. Promotions show a countdown. Complete payment and return to retrieve account details.

Your reseller panel
Use the displayed link and credentials. Keep them safe. Access depends on account validity; contact support for frozen or expired accounts.

Generate codes
Choose a subscription or a 2, 3 or 6 hour test. Check the duration before generating. Customers activate separately supplied codes on ACTIVATION CODE; in-app purchases use automatic activation.

Check
Use Settings or the update invitation in the app.

Download
Internal downloads display progress on Home. Return after interruption to resume when supported by the server. Do not clear app data during download.

Install
Follow the Android installation prompt. If required, authorize installations from Barka Tunnel, then return. Android controls this permission.

After installation
Reopen the app, check ABOUT and allow synchronization. If Android refuses an older version, contact support before uninstalling to avoid losing local data.
